summary: An experimental generative soundscape firmware with two modes: Bioma, a synthesized ecosystem of birds, insects and water, and Atolls, a pair of sample loopers.
features: Bioma: Birds, Insects and Water respond; Wind, Drift, Beam shape it
Atolls: two independent sample loops with movable windows and Fragments
Landing points that Flock and V Format move between
MIDI notes and CCs for both modes; MIDI clock optional
Browser editor writes four sample slots of up to 7.4 seconds
Built on Felucca and SLOOP; MIDI tested on the author's unit
